message:
♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.0.1 IS OFFICIALLY LIVE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**[cite: 2]

We just dropped a fresh update focused on making your workflow smoother, faster, and more reliable[cite: 2]. Version 9.0.1 introduces a dynamic new Highlighter tool, crystal-clear AutoCaption progress tracking, rock-solid custom dropdown menus, and updated AI transcription tiers[cite: 2].

*(Tip: Completely close and restart After Effects after updating so your panel loads all the new changes cleanly[cite: 2].)*

♦️ **Brand-New Dynamic Highlighter Tool (FX & ADVANCED RIGS)**
Add clean, customizable text highlights in seconds[cite: 2]. The highlight automatically resizes and reflows whenever you edit your words, font, or text size—saving you from rebuilding layers or fixing broken keyframes[cite: 2]. Choose between Box, Baseline Underline, or Strikethrough styles, pick from 9 growth directions, and adjust padding, colors, and blend modes directly inside the panel without digging through your timeline[cite: 2]. You can even send your controls straight to the Essential Graphics Panel for instant MOGRT export[cite: 2].

♦️ **Real-Time 5-Stage AutoCaption Progress**
No more guessing where your transcription is stuck or waiting on a fake timer[cite: 2]. AutoCaptions now clearly tracks your job across 5 live stages: Prepare · Connect · Upload · Transcribe · Captions[cite: 2]. You can see your actual upload file size, check which engine is actively answering, and monitor completed steps at a glance[cite: 2].

♦️ **Glitch-Free Custom Dropdowns**
We replaced 19 native menus across the panel with custom, responsive dropdowns[cite: 2]. They open instantly on the first click without freezing, display active checkmarks for your current selection, and automatically flip upward when working near the bottom of your display[cite: 2].

♦️ **Transparent AI Model Tiers & Fixes**
Transcription models are now clearly labeled so you know exactly what you are using: Flex Ai 3.5 Turbo (Most accurate) and Flex v1-Flash (Somewhat accurate)[cite: 2]. We also resolved several UI bugs: collapsed sections now stay collapsed between reloads, cut-off section headers are fixed, and your credit balance remains visible across every model tier[cite: 2].
